# PiTTy v0.6.66

- **Every known command in `/`:** No 24-result cap or prioritized-only list. Use the existing scrollable suggestion panel to browse all commands exposed by Pi extensions, templates, skills, and PiTTy UI.
- **Compaction and running jobs:** The compaction panel shows active shell commands, task IDs and elapsed time. Select a row to open the existing background-task output dialog. Finished tasks do not occupy compaction space. The list is height-bounded on short terminals.
- **Separate model checkpoint update:** pi-one-round-compaction v0.4.5 can also preserve running background-command IDs and short descriptions in its deterministic checkpoint. Upgrade that extension separately after active work finishes.

No active Pi sessions or background tasks are interrupted by staging. Restart PiTTy after current agents finish to activate this release.
